findings.summary: A denial and its correction were collapsed into a single assertion, removing the misreading the paragraph was correcting.

evidence.baseline: The crisis of modern economics is not that money is the only currency. It is that money has become the only currency civilization has built sophisticated infrastructure to recognize
evidence.shipped: The crisis of modern economics is that money has become the only currency for which civilization has built sophisticated infrastructure

findings.authorizedBy: R-NEGATION-STACK, and catalog 4.3 read onto the not-X-but-Y pair.
findings.diagnosis: R-NEGATION-STACK governs stacked denials before a claim. There is one denial here, not a stack, and its retention limb applies squarely: the error being corrected is itself the subject. The paragraph has just established that every economy is already plural, so the reader arrives believing money is one currency among many. The denial names the misreading a reader would otherwise make, that the crisis is monopoly, and the correction supplies the real claim, that the crisis is infrastructure. Without the denial the paragraph asserts the second without ever engaging the first.

findings.summary: Three repeated betweens naming three kinds of relationship became one series.

evidence.baseline: a system for organizing relationship: between human beings and resources, between labor and value, between present consumption and future consequence
evidence.shipped: a system for organizing relationship: between people and resources, labor and value, present consumption and future consequence

findings.diagnosis: Each between opens a distinct relation, and the three are not commensurable: one is between a species and a substance, one between an activity and an abstraction, one between two moments in time. Sharing a single preposition makes them three items of one kind. Human beings is also the volume's term where a body is at stake, and the first pair is the one where a body is at stake.

findings.summary: An em dash pair enclosing five currencies became a comma series that read as an inventory.

evidence.baseline: while the other currencies [mark] trust, regeneration, meaning, ecological reciprocity, relational depth [mark] move through architectures that are primitive
evidence.shipped: while trust, regeneration, meaning, ecological reciprocity, and relational depth move through architectures that are primitive

findings.authorizedBy: R-PUNCT-STRUCT, applied by absorbing the pair into the subject.
findings.diagnosis: The pass deleted the other currencies, which was the phrase binding the five to the claim about plurality two sentences earlier, and closed the series with and, which asserts that these five are the others. Repaired here by moving the enumeration behind a colon at the end of the sentence, which keeps the frame, keeps the series open, and lands the paragraph on five concrete nouns rather than on a description of architecture.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The kept litany is the useful evidence here. Four consecutive three-word sentences with identical shape survived untouched while three repeated betweens inside one sentence did not. The pass was not normalizing parallelism as such; it was normalizing repeated function words within a single sentence, which is a much narrower and more mechanical habit than the catalog categories it was invoking.
